scope: On FreeEnergyReals, over Mathlib's reals, finite states and outcomes, and one policy with its predicted distribution over states given: expected free energy, risk (the divergence of the predicted outcomes from the preferred ones) plus ambiguity (the expected entropy of the likelihood), is the negative of the epistemic value less the pragmatic value (the expected log preference), with no hypothesis. The epistemic value is the divergence of the joint weights of states and outcomes from the product of the states' weights and the predicted outcomes, nonnegative where these are distributions, and the predicted outcomes' average of the divergence of FreeEnergyReals' posterior given each outcome from the states' weights. Where the likelihood reads a state only through its class, the epistemic value and the expected free energy are the classes', with their total weights, so two beliefs alike on the classes have one expected free energy; one likelihood for every state the policy may reach gives epistemic value nothing, and two states of one likelihood keep their prior ratio in the posterior under every outcome. On Becoming.LumpedSeeking, for courses of experiments each chosen from the course so far, the hidden state fixed: the posterior after a course, FreeEnergyReals' posterior of the prior times the course's likelihood, is, with a nonnegative prior and likelihoods and where the course weighs something, the belief of least free energy among those zero wherever the joint weights are; choice weights reading the course drop out of it wherever they weigh something; with natural weights and the hypotheses listed once it is the core's share given a listed course whose choices weigh something, and the core's order of two shares given it is the order of the posterior. Choosing by a rule with natural weights reading the experiments' expected free energies is one of the core's policies, so the core's law holds at it (an instance, whatever the agent's model); over the reals a pair every experiment ties keeps its prior ratio in the posterior after every course, and its strict order where the course is possible under it and weighs something, so also under every policy whose choices weigh something, the softmax among them. Where every experiment's likelihood reads a state only through its class, conditioning commutes with the lumping: at the posterior after every course every experiment's expected free energy and epistemic value are the classes', and two priors alike on the classes choose alike under every rule and give every course one predictive weight, so for any likelihoods seeking by expected free energy reads the prior only through the weight it gives each likelihood profile. Mathlib's conventions log 0 = 0 and x / 0 = 0 hold: where the predicted outcomes weigh an outcome of preference nothing, risk and pragmatic value are finite here though infinite as usually defined. That the weights are probabilities and the likelihood an agent's generative model are correspondences, not checked.
